# CARTA - Cambodia AI, Robotics and Technology Transfer Association

> CARTA (Cambodia AI, Robotics and Technology Transfer Association) is a leading national association driving the advancement of Artificial Intelligence, humanoid robotics, smart city innovation, and cross-border technology transfer in the Kingdom of Cambodia.

## Overview
CARTA bridges education, industry, government, and research institutions to accelerate Cambodia's transition into a high-value digital economy. Founded under the auspices of national technological initiatives, CARTA facilitates research, technology commercialization, and talent incubation.

## Core Focus Areas
- **Artificial Intelligence**: Generative AI, natural language processing for Khmer, predictive analytics, and machine vision.
- **Humanoid Robotics & Automation**: Industrial IoT, smart manufacturing, service robots, and robotic automation.
- **Smart Cities & Urban Tech**: Intelligent urban infrastructure, smart mobility, and sustainability systems.
- **Technology Transfer**: Commercializing academic research and fostering cross-border tech licensing.
- **Deep Tech Research & Incubation**: Supporting tech founders and high-tech research centers across Cambodia.
